divergence: The independent TU reconstructs OSInit control flow and calls, but the candidate is 884 bytes versus the 920-byte target. The original combined SDK TU hoists the local OS string-pool base into r31 and static DriveInfo base into r30 at entry and preserves the arena-high value in r29; this independent TU instead hoists its private rodata base before the standard prologue, delays DriveInfo materialization until the DVD tail, and uses r30 for the arena-high value.
